english.title: Use of a pedal cycle without lights at night
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a pedal cycle in motion at a time between sunset and sunrise when the

(A)_[front position lamp]_
(B)_[rear position lamp]_
(C)_[front and rear position lamps]_

required to by fitted by the Road Vehicles Lighting Regulations 1989

(D)_[was]_
(E)_[were]_

not kept lit and unobscured
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 24(1)(a) of the Road Vehicles Lighting Regulations 1989 and section 91 of the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location

english.notes:
(i) See regulation 24(9) for exceptions.
(ii) See offence wordings H275 and H277 when during the hours of darkness.
(iii) See also offence wordings H274, H276 and H278 when the visibility is seriously reduced.
(iv) Fixed penalty scheme may be applied.
